experience_section.title: One of the Rarest Wildlife Events on Earth
experience_section.intro: Ostional National Wildlife Refuge is one of the few beaches in the world where olive ridley sea turtles come ashore by the thousands to nest, a phenomenon known as the arribada. On this private night tour, you'll walk the shoreline under moonlight with a certified local community guide, watching these ancient creatures dig their nests and lay their eggs just steps away.

items.title: Olive Ridley Sea Turtles
items.description: Ostional is one of only a handful of nesting beaches on the planet where olive ridley turtles nest in mass synchronized arrivals, a natural event found in very few places worldwide.

items.title: Guided Night Walk
items.description: Certified local community guides, required by the refuge for all beach access after dark, lead the walk using red-light flashlights that do not disturb nesting turtles.

items.title: Community-Protected Refuge
items.description: Ostional is managed in partnership with the local community, whose guides fund conservation work through regulated, small-group beach access.

items.title: A Genuine Wild Encounter
items.description: No enclosures, no staged sightings, just wild turtles on a wild beach. Sightings depend on nature and cannot be guaranteed, but the experience of the beach itself is unforgettable.

footer.title: A Long Journey Worth Taking
footer.text: Ostional sits on the Nicoya Peninsula, a substantial private drive from Papagayo. This is a long day into night, but for travelers who want to witness one of Costa Rica's most extraordinary natural events, it is worth every hour on the road.

before_you_arrive: This is a long private day into night, expect roughly 10-11 hours round trip including drive time. Plan a lighter following day.
Turtle sightings occur in a natural, wild environment and cannot be guaranteed on any single visit, though sightings are frequent during arribada season.
Wear dark or neutral clothing and avoid white light or flash photography, both disturb nesting turtles and are restricted on the refuge beach.
Beach access after dark is only permitted with a certified local community guide, this is a refuge regulation, not a Wild Papagayo policy.
Bring cash for the local community guide fee and any gratuities.
Please inform us of any mobility limitations at booking, the beach walk is on natural sand.
reservation_policy_extra: Because local community guide availability is limited and coordinated in advance, date changes must be requested more than 72 hours before the tour and remain subject to guide availability.

faq.question: Is this a private tour?
faq.answer: Yes, transportation and your driver-guide are private and exclusive to your group. Beach access after dark is coordinated with a certified local community guide, a refuge regulation, not a Wild Papagayo policy.

faq.question: Is hotel pickup included?
faq.answer: Yes. Private pickup and return are included from Papagayo, Playa Hermosa and Playas del Coco.

faq.question: How much does this tour cost?
faq.answer: Pricing is confirmed directly with our concierge based on your pickup zone and group size, contact us on WhatsApp for a custom quote.

faq.question: Will we definitely see turtles?
faq.answer: Turtle nesting occurs in a wild, natural environment and cannot be guaranteed on any single visit, though sightings are frequent, especially during arribada season.

faq.question: When is the best time to go?
faq.answer: The mass nesting arribada typically occurs between August and November, though exact dates vary by year. Outside these months, individual turtles still nest but less predictably.

faq.question: Is this tour suitable for young children?
faq.answer: Due to the long drive and very late return, a minimum age of 6 is recommended for comfort, though this is a practical suggestion rather than a refuge requirement.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Dark or neutral-colored clothing, comfortable closed-toe shoes, a light jacket, insect repellent, and cash for the local community guide fee.
